ORBIS Earth3D rendering attribution
==================================

Visual engine adapted from mitchcamza / Earth3D:
https://github.com/mitchcamza/Earth3D
Pinned source revision: 1d151516f8041e5bec91aee83f7d8261e9f6604d

Shader techniques credited upstream to Bruno Simon's Three.js Journey:
https://threejs-journey.com/

TEXTURES
The following original image files are vendored unchanged from the pinned
Earth3D repository's static/textures directory:

2k_earth_daymap.jpg (2048 x 1024)
night.jpg (4096 x 2048)
specularClouds.jpg (4096 x 2048; red = specular mask, green = clouds)

Earth day/night maps and cloud imagery: Solar System Scope.
https://www.solarsystemscope.com/textures/
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Specular mapping credit (as documented by Earth3D): James Hastings-Trew,
Planet Pixel Emporium: https://planetpixelemporium.com/planets.html

Earth3D README attribution:
https://github.com/mitchcamza/Earth3D/blob/1d151516f8041e5bec91aee83f7d8261e9f6604d/README.md

These are static visual composites, NOT live cloud/weather observations.
All geographic boundaries and labels remain the existing Natural Earth data.
All satellite/debris positions, trajectories, epochs, ACI, ML classifications
and screening results remain supplied by the existing ORBIS backend.

ADAPTATIONS
Only surface/atmosphere shaders and three texture files were ported.
React Three Fiber owns the existing responsive canvas and renderer lifecycle.
ORBIS's existing OrbitControls, starfield and zoom-dependent geography remain.
UV longitude is mirrored to match ORBIS's +X Greenwich / +Y north / +Z east
coordinate convention. The standalone axial tilt and independently rotating
Earth were deliberately not copied: camera auto-rotation must not shift the
geographic surface away from ECEF positions. Solar direction comes from the
existing backend environment endpoint at the current live/replay epoch.
The twilight uniform naming and the packed texture path are corrected from
the standalone demo. Ocean specular reflection is implemented in the shader.
Standalone analytics, debug objects and application shell were not imported.
